mechanisms.behavior: Optional cabinet redemption/ticket interface: public 32 enables the 12 V dispenser at Node 1 CN11-3; input 88 is its notch pulse atCN 11-5. Own 23 connector table names 12 V, ground, enable and notch; factory 1.11 fixes dispenser operation and 1.14 fixes ticket-meter/Redemption flipper configuration.1.16 supports an eWallet pseudo-ticket device as another configured consumer. Factory 502-6109 kit ships DL-1275 STANDARD: enabling starts the feed motor; one low 10..60 ms notch pulse per ticket, typically 300..500 ms spacing; ROM removes enable after the required count. Paper blockage/no notch pulses require paper/jam handling rather than a fabricated switch edge. Physical motor remains off with enable low.
